info.name: OmniFlux REST API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for OmniFlux — the native C++17 libtorrent and Swift BitTorrent client for macOS. Covers torrent lifecycle management, HTTP 206 byte-range streaming, file priority control, session swarm statistics, Jackett/DHT search, and real-time MalwareBazaar threat scanning.
